grades.quote: When the ERTN instruction is executed to return from the exception handler, if CSR.MERRCTL.IsMERR=1, the hardware restores the value of the PPLV field of CSR.MERRCTL to here
grades.reason: States that on ERTN the hardware restores CRMD.PLV from the PPLV field of MERRCTL, TLBRPRMD or PRMD, depending on the exception type. This covers the privilege-level part of the restored state, but not PC or the interrupt-enable and other fields.

grades.quote: the hardware records the PC of the instruction that triggered the exception here.
grades.reason: Describes how ERA records the PC when an exception is triggered. That is the source of the return address, but the passage never mentions ERTN or what it restores.

grades.quote:
When CSR.DBG.DM=1, the return address is fetched from here|
||||when the ERTN instruction is executed.
grades.reason: The passage says that when CSR.DBG.DM=1, ERTN takes the return address (PC) from DERA. That covers one part of the state ERTN restores, the PC for a debug exception. It does not cover the general case, such as ERA or the PRMD-to-CRMD restoration of privilege level and interrupt enable.

grades.quote: The value stored here is used as the return address when the ERTN instruction is executed to return from the machine error exception handler (when CSR.MERRCTL.IsMERR=1).
grades.reason: Says ERTN uses MERRERA as the return address when returning from a machine error exception (IsMERR=1). This is the PC-restore part, but only for the machine-error case.
